payload.title: Exporter: `papyrus content export-published` (published and drafts -> Markus build input) and round-trip check
payload.description:
## Goal
`papyrus content export-published`: write the CMS content back out as a directory the existing Markus static build consumes unchanged (`build_markus_site(content_dir=...)`), from either the guest-visible `Published*` projection (production) or the drafts (`--drafts`, staging). Plus a round-trip check proving import -> export reproduces the original content and builds identical HTML. This is the "Markus static reads the CMS" half of the content contract (docs/standard-site.md 1.8).

## Context (verified)
- Build input contract: `src/papyrus_content/markus_renderer/build.py`: `<content>/articles/*.md` required; extra section dirs via `sections=`; `<content>/assets` copied to the output; per-file front matter; `markus_renderer/commands.py` `markus_build(flags)` = `papyrus renderers markus-build --content DIR --out DIR --theme T` (already a ported command). Reader repos have their own build scripts (`Pilobol.us/web/build_via_papyrus.py`, Anth.us `build_via_papyrus.py`) that call `build_markus_site` on a directory; they only need the directory.
- `PPY-b3a10e` writes `Item`/`PublishedItem` with `bodyMarkus`, `metadata.frontMatterYaml`, `metadata.source.path`, `aliases`; `PPY-22a3b4` writes `MediaAsset` with `metadata.srcPath`, `storagePath`; `PublishedMediaAsset` has the same columns (copied at publish). `compose_source(front_matter_yaml, body_markus)` (`PPY-e169c5`) rebuilds the file text.
- Auth: CLI uses `create_authoring_client()` (`PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_JWT`; `papyrus auth refresh-jwt` mints one from the SSM secret; in Amplify builds the build role reads that secret, docs/standard-site.md 1.6). Drafts need the JWT lane or an editor token (`Item` is editor/admin/custom only); published rows are readable with the same JWT. S3 reads use boto3 default credentials (build role / OIDC role).
- Reader-owned static files (JS/CSS/HTML under `assets/`) stay in the publication repo; the reader build overlays them on the exported tree.

## Exact changes
1. `src/papyrus_content/markus_export.py` (new):
   ```python
   def export_content(client, store: MediaStore, out_dir: Path, *, drafts: bool, clean: bool = False, allow_empty: bool = False) -> ExportReport
   def item_output_path(item: dict) -> str     # "articles/hello.md"
   ```
   Source rows: published mode lists `PublishedItem` with `status == "published"` and `type in ("article","page")`; drafts mode lists `Item` with `type in ("article","page")` and any status (a draft shows as if published; no marker in the files). Output path = `metadata.source.path` when its first segment equals the item's `section` (or the item has no section and the path has one segment), else `"{section}/{slug}.md"` or `"{slug}.md"`; reject absolute paths, `..`, non-`.md`, and two items with the same path (error lists both). File text = `compose_source(metadata.frontMatterYaml, bodyMarkus)`, written UTF-8 with the body verbatim.
   Media: for every media row of an exported item (`PublishedMediaAsset` by `publishedItemId`, or `MediaAsset` by `itemId`) `store.get(storagePath, out_dir / metadata.srcPath)`; skip when the file exists with the same sha256 (`metadata.sha256`). Create parent dirs. (`store` is `S3MediaStore` from `PPY-22a3b4`; `DirMediaStore` in tests.)
   Side files: `out_dir/_papyrus/manifest.json` and `out_dir/_papyrus/redirects.json` (the builds ignore `_`-prefixed dirs; verify against `_discover_markdown`).
   Fail closed: any GraphQL/S3 error raises; zero exported items exits 1 unless `allow_empty` (a CMS outage must fail the build, never publish an empty site).
   `clean=True` deletes `out_dir` first (never anything outside it; refuse when `out_dir` is `/` or the home dir or contains `.git`).
2. CLI `papyrus content export-published --out DIR [--drafts] [--clean] [--allow-empty] [--bucket B] [--json]` in `src/papyrus_content/markus_export_commands.py`; wire in `cli.py` (`PORTED_COMMANDS`, `dispatch`, `print_usage`). Reuse `S3MediaStore` from `markus_import.py` (move `MediaStore`, `S3MediaStore`, `DirMediaStore` into `src/papyrus_content/media_store.py` in whichever of `PPY-22a3b4`/`PPY-1d0f3d` lands first; the second imports it).
3. `scripts/verify-markus-roundtrip.sh <content-dir> [--drafts-map drafts=articles]` (new, bash 5 not required): `import-markus` into the configured (sandbox) backend, `export-published` to a temp dir, then `papyrus renderers markus-build` twice (original dir and exported dir, `--theme hackerman`) and `diff -r` the two `dist` trees; prints `ROUNDTRIP OK` or the diff and exits 1. The reader-owned assets are copied into both trees first (`cp -R <content-dir>/assets/. <tree>/assets/` for non-image files).
4. Fixture `procedures/newsroom/tests/fixtures/markus-content/` is shared with `PPY-22a3b4` (created there; if EXP lands first, create it here and note it).

## Data shapes
`_papyrus/manifest.json`:
```json
{"contract": "papyrus-export/v1", "mode": "published", "generatedAt": "2026-10-06T12:00:00Z", "site": "pilobol-us",
 "items": [{"id": "item-articles-hello", "slug": "hello", "section": "articles", "path": "articles/hello.md", "status": "published", "versionNumber": 2, "contentHash": "sha256:..."}],
 "media": [{"srcPath": "assets/hello/a.png", "storagePath": "media/assets/hello/a.png", "sha256": "..."}]}
```
`_papyrus/redirects.json` (from `aliases`; consumed by the reader build to produce Amplify `customRules` or the site's own `custom-rules.json`):
```json
[{"from": "/blog/hello-old", "to": "/articles/hello.html", "status": 301}]
```
`to` is the canonical built path (`/{section}/{slug}.html`, root pages `/{slug}.html`).

## Tests
- Unit `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_markus_export.py` (`FakeAuthoringClient`, `DirMediaStore`): published mode excludes drafts and unpublished items; drafts mode includes them; path rules (source path kept, `drafts/wip.md` item in section `articles` exports to `articles/wip.md`); duplicate path error; path traversal error; empty result -> exit 1, `--allow-empty` -> exit 0; media downloaded to `srcPath`, unchanged files skipped on re-export; manifest/redirects content; GraphQL error propagates (non-zero).
- Round trip in-process: `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_markus_roundtrip.py`: import the fixture dir (`PPY-22a3b4` with fakes), export, then assert every `.md` is BYTE-identical to the source (fixtures use canonical fences) and image bytes identical; then `build_markus_site` on both trees (needs `markus` 0.5.1 and Pillow; mark `skipUnless(shutil.which("markus"))`) and assert the output trees are identical (`filecmp.dircmp` recursive).
- Gherkin: `features_backend/markus-export.feature` + steps: "Exporting published content writes only published items", "Exporting drafts includes unpublished items", "An empty export fails", "Aliases become redirect rules".
- Real content: run `scripts/verify-markus-roundtrip.sh /tmp/pilobol-src/web/content --drafts-map drafts=articles` against a sandbox and record `ROUNDTRIP OK`; for Anth.us record the result of the same script on the normalized directory in Phase 3 (not here).

## Acceptance checks
- `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.test_markus_export procedures.newsroom.tests.test_markus_roundtrip -v` passes.
- `poetry run behave features_backend/markus-export.feature` passes.
- Sandbox: `scripts/verify-markus-roundtrip.sh` prints `ROUNDTRIP OK` for the Pilobol.us content.
- `poetry run papyrus content export-published --out /tmp/x --json` against an empty backend exits 1 with "no items".

## Dependencies
Blocked by `PPY-b3a10e` (record shapes, `FakeAuthoringClient`), `PPY-e169c5` (`compose_source`), `PPY-44a0f9`; round-trip needs `PPY-22a3b4`. Blocks `PPY-f00c89` (drafts export for the static staging build) and Phase 3. Same-file conflicts: `cli.py`, `graphql_authoring.py` `INDEX_DEFINITIONS` (add `publishedMediaAssetsByItemAndSortKey`/`mediaAssetsByItemAndSortKey` only if `PPY-b3a10e` has not).

## Risks
- Byte-identity relies on canonical front-matter fences; files with trailing blank lines before the closing fence differ in bytes but not in rendered HTML (the HTML diff is the real criterion).
- Draft items exported as published pages leak nothing as long as the output is served only behind the staging gate (`PPY-f00c89`); never upload a drafts export to a public bucket (the command prints the mode in `manifest.json`, and `PPY-f00c89` refuses a `drafts` manifest on the production path).
- Large media sets: first export downloads everything; keep it incremental (sha256 skip).

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-1d0f3d-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
